resale_co.name: Certificate of Compliance (Borough Code Section 106-25)
resale_co.issued_by: Garwood Fire Department, Bureau of Fire Prevention and Code Enforcement
resale_co.lead_time: Apply more than 10 business days before closing for the lowest fee
resale_co.valid_for: If the change of occupancy does not happen within six months, a new application fee is required
requirements: Smoke alarm on each level including the basement (not unfinished attics or crawl spaces), near the stairs, and within 10 feet of each bedroom; habitable attics need one
Carbon monoxide alarm outside each separate sleeping area within 10 feet of bedrooms if the home has a fuel-burning appliance or an attached garage
All smoke and CO alarms working; all alarms less than 10 years old; battery smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units (since January 1, 2019)
AC powered or interconnected alarms installed after January 1977 must be kept working
The existing use must be a proper use in the zone (zoning officer certification if the use is nonconforming or by variance)
No roof drain, sump pump or other stormwater may drain into the Borough sanitary sewer; any such connection must be moved to the storm system before the certificate is issued
No open building permits; final inspections must be scheduled through the Building Department

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Application for Certificate of Compliance (fillable PDF), check every box, and send it with a check or money order payable to Borough of Garwood to the Borough of Garwood, 403 South Avenue, Garwood. The Fire Department (Fire Prevention Bureau) then inspects. Questions: fireprevention@garwood.org.

evidence.quote: A certificate of compliance shall be required to be obtained prior to occupancy after the sale or conveyance of any residential, commercial, industrial, institutional, mixed use or other property or structure within the Borough.
No person shall occupy such property after such sale or conveyance unless such certificate of compliance shall be obtained from the Garwood Fire Department.

The application fee shall be $70 if requested more than 10 business days prior to the change of occupant, $100 if requested four to 10 business days prior to the change of occupant and $200 if requested fewer than four business days prior to the change of occupant.
Once issued a certificate is not transferrable, nor is a fee refundable. If change of occupancy does not occur within six months, a new application fee shall be required.
No Certificate of Compliance will be issued until all open building permits are closed.
For information regarding Inspections please email: FIREPREVENTION@GARWOOD.ORG or contact the Fire Sub Code Official at: 908-477-6752.
Completed forms with fees should be sent to the Borough of Garwood, 403 South Avenue, Garwood.
Contact the Bureau of Fire Prevention and Code Enforcement at: fireprevention@garwood.org or by phone at 908.477.6752
LEAID: 2006-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official Leonard Spina Phone (908) 789-8877 Addr: 403 South Av Garwood NJ 07027 Phone (908) 789-3438 ... Email fireprevention@garwood.org

resale_co.notes: Garwood's resale certificate and the state smoke/CO certificate are one combined Certificate of Compliance issued by the Fire Department, so the same fee covers both. The ordinance text on the form says 4 to 10 business days costs $100 and fewer than 4 costs $200; the fee note on page 1 words the tiers slightly differently (fewer than ten but more than four; four or fewer). The contact name comes from the state fire directory (survey dated July 2025); the Borough website names no person for fire prevention and gives 908.477.6752 (Fire Sub Code Official / Bureau of Fire Prevention and Code Enforcement). The form header lists the Fire Department at (908) 789-8877, 415 South Avenue. Rental-only items: the Borough has rental registration, rental inspection and change of occupancy forms for landlords (Ordinance 23-07), which are not resale requirements.
